caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional scene mounted on a rectangular base. The base is decorated in yellow and red, with a border of black dots inside a red strip above bold yellow text reading "JONAH AND THE WHALE." On top of the base is a mold of greenish-grey waves. On the left, there is a brown wooden boat with red and blue details inside, and a human figure wearing a red garment and a white head covering is partially bent over the side of the boat, facing right. The figure's arms are extended outward and one foot appears to be raised, as if about to be thrown out or falling. Directly to the right is a large, dark green whale with a wide open mouth showing a pinkish-red interior and visible teeth, as well as a yellow eye. The whale is positioned as if emerging from the waves toward the person in the boat. The composition centers on the dramatic interaction between the person, the boat, and the whale.
title: Toy Bank
